remove the cover of stop valve (81) (see figure 9)

Connect the gas supplying 
adaptor (82) to body of stop valve (83) when high pressure SF6 is filled in the

1200-2000A | Once every 200 operations
600-1200A | Once every 500 operations

phenomena should occur
No. | Symptoms | Cause | Remedy
1 | Overheat of contact | 1 . Poor contact | Replace wiper spring
2 . Ingress of foreign substances to contact surface or rough main contact | (a) Remove foreign substances.
 (b) Polish contact surface
 (Replace, if remarkably roughened)
2 | Failure in closing spring charging operation | 1. Damage or burn out of motor | Replace the motor by new one
2. Fault of motor switch | Replace the motor switch by new one
3. Damage 
 for the ratchet wheel or pawls | Replace the 
 ratchet wheel or pawls
3 | Failure in interrupting operation | 1. Broken wire or erroneous wiring of opening circuit | Recheck circuit
2. Poor contact of auxiliary switch | (a) If auxiliary switch lever of on/off shifting operation is found improper, adjusting shifting
 (b) If auxiliary switch 
 contact wipe is poor, increase wipe or replace auxiliary switch
 (c) Should incomplete contact of auxiliary switch be caused by looseness 
 of mounting bolts, retighten them
3. Broken wire of layer short of tripping coil | Replace coil
4. Breakage of link, etc, on control system | Replace broken parts
5. Operating voltage drop | Check the battery or AC input source
6. Gas pressure drop | Repair leak places and supply gas
4 | Failure of closing operation | 1. Broken wire of erroneous wiring 
 of closing control circuit | Recheck circuit
2. Broken wire or layer short of coil | Replace oil
3. Malfunction of hook | Eliminate increased friction and replace defective parts
4. Breakage of closing spring | Replace spring
5. Gas pressure drop | Supply gas and repair leak places
5 | Gas leakage | 1. 
 Incomplete insertion packing into groove or hole on seal, or damaged gasket | Reweld seal part gasket
2. Defective welding or defective material | Reweld or replace parts
3. Loose joints | Check fastenings
